gpt-5.4-mini.Description: High-quality GPT-5 model offering strong reasoning, professional content creation, editing, SEO writing, and multimodal understanding. Excellent balance of writing quality, speed, and cost for advanced business and creative workflows.

gpt-5.4-nano.Description: Compact GPT-5 model optimized for speed and cost efficiency. Best for lightweight reasoning, extraction, formatting, validation, and utility tasks rather than premium-quality creative writing.

gpt-4o-mini.Description: Affordable, fast, and versatile OpenAI model with strong general writing, editing, summarization, and structured-output capabilities. Well-suited for high-volume content generation and business workflows.

gpt-4.1-nano.Description: Ultra-fast and lowest-cost OpenAI model designed for lightweight tasks such as classification, tagging, extraction, validation, and simple automation workflows. Not recommended for advanced content generation or editing.

gemini-3-flash-preview.Description: High-intelligence fast model optimized for real-time generation, retrieval-augmented tasks, and high-quality content drafting with strong reasoning and grounding. Best used for production-level content generation where speed and quality must both be high.

gemini-2.5-flash.Description: Balanced reasoning model with strong performance for structured content generation, summarization, and light-to-medium writing tasks. Supports long context (up to 1M tokens) and is well-suited for multi-step workflows such as research → draft → revise pipelines.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.Description: Ultra-low cost, high-throughput model optimized for simple, repetitive tasks such as classification, extraction, formatting, validation, and lightweight summarization. Not suitable for high-quality content writing or editorial work.

gemini-1.5-pro.Description: High-quality reasoning and writing model designed for long-form content, complex analysis, editing, and SEO content generation. Excellent for polished outputs and multi-step agent workflows.

gemini-1.5-flash.Description: Ultra-fast and cost-efficient model optimized for high-volume tasks such as summarization, extraction, and lightweight content generation. Best used in pipeline stages where speed matters more than writing quality.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct.Description: High-end vision-language model for multimodal understanding. Best for document parsing, image analysis, and complex structured extraction.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct.Description: Balanced general-purpose reasoning model. Good for content generation, summarization, and agent workflows.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct.Description: Strong coding and structured reasoning model. Excellent for JSON generation, tool use, and logic-heavy tasks. Very reliable for LangGraph nodes requiring strict output formats.

meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct.Description: High-quality reasoning and writing model for editing, content generation, and agent workflows.

meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.Description: Fast lightweight reasoning model for routing and simple generation.

mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1.Description: Mixture-of-Experts model with strong reasoning ability. Great for structured writing and multi-step agent workflows.

mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2.Description: Efficient general-purpose model. Best for summarization, formatting, and lightweight generation tasks.

microsoft/phi-3-medium-4k-instruct.Description: Balanced reasoning model for structured tasks and moderate content generation. Good for cost-efficient agent steps.

microsoft/phi-3-mini-4k-instruct.Description: Ultra-efficient small model for classification and lightweight reasoning. Ideal for routing, validation, and preprocessing tasks.

qwen/Qwen3-Coder-32B.Description: Strong structured reasoning model for code and JSON generation.

llama3-70b-8192.Description: High-quality reasoning and content generation model.

llama3-8b-8192.Description: Ultra-fast lightweight model for routing, classification, and simple tasks.

mixtral-8x7b-32768.Description: Mixture-of-Experts model optimized for long context reasoning and structured output.
